prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though some changes like compact layouts outperformed predictions.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though one specific placement hurt.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) either hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for all change kinds tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to state a rule.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Story Scroll Layout Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen with a vertical story scroll layout that displays pet traits and animated previews. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate in the core funnel (62.1%) with an 89s median completion time, showing friction during pet evaluation.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Welcome Story Companion Choice Screen: Insert a new story intro screen immediately after the story screen to set companion expectations before path selection. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean duration of 514s and a drop-off rate of 23.9%, indicating initial hesitation before choosing an adoption path.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Pick Screen: Move the sign-in step to occur right after selecting a pet from the pick friend screen. (why: Support emails show 8 reports of missing/reset pets after sign-in. Asking users to sign in after picking their pet establishes clear ownership before photo/certificate creation.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Interactive Companion Audio Onboarding Flow: Introduce an interactive sound component on the final intro screen allowing users to trigger test audio clips of their pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to interact with or talk to the pet, and the finish step suffers a 64.8% drop with a 5815s mean duration.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Interactive Animation Progress Display: Add an animated progress element and step counter component during the pet generation wait screen. (why: The home wait step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing 15.6% of users to drop out before completion.)
5: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Two Column Layout Redesign: Change the upload photos screen layout to a two-column view separating photo submission from formatting tips. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet photo creation issues, and adoption step drop-off remains high at 37.9%.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Quick Setup Welcome Copy: Update story screen headline and body text to highlight the fast and simple 2-minute setup process. (why: Choose path takes an average of 514s, indicating users pause to evaluate commitment before starting.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Sync Helper Text Hint: Add a text component hint clarifying that signing in backs up the pet profile across app restarts. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
8: [adoption, notification] Photo Upload Instant Processing Confirmation Notification: Add a badge component on the photo upload screen confirming instant automatic image processing. (why: 3 support emails highlighted custom pet rendering failures, causing user anxiety during photo upload in the adoption step.)
